tasks.checklist: Checklist (one item per line, up to 50)
tasks.snapshotHelp: Templates define reusable work. Each selected session/group or student gets an independent copy. Later template edits do not change assigned tasks or their completion. Selecting both a whole target and a student creates two separate tasks.
tasks.narrow: Narrow the session date filter to see more targets (200 sessions / 5,000 memberships per selection).
tasks.empty: No tasks assigned to this session.
tasks.confirmDelete: Delete this assigned task and its checklist progress?
tasks.noPrevious: No earlier active session is available.

generation.title: Create planned sessions
generation.help: A schedule defines the teacher, target and recurrence. This creates real planned session records after its last stored sequence; moved, canceled and archived occurrences are not recreated. A period-count plan means four planned sessions per requested period, per schedule. Actual periods form only when sessions receive answers. Templates assign work to existing sessions and never create sessions.
generation.warning: Confirm carefully: this will create {{count}} new session records on the dates and for the targets listed below. Past dates are included if shown. Existing sessions will not be changed.
generation.confirm: I reviewed the targets, dates and number of sessions.

assignment.help: Choose whole groups and/or individual memberships. Each selected target gets its own schedule in one operation. Selecting a parent alone targets that group; Select branch adds its descendants. Sessions are created separately.
assignment.limit: Only the first 5,000 active memberships are shown.

scope.shared: These selections are shared by Dashboard, Results and Export. Group selection includes descendants. Empty selections include all available items.
scope.allAssignments: All assignments in the selected groups
scope.allPeriods: All periods in the selected assignments
scope.empty: No answered periods match this selection.
scope.details: Details use the selected assignments and periods. Each assignment-period is shown separately; students are counted once in the overview.

tree.branchHelp: Use the count beside a branch to select or clear the whole branch.

orbits.help: Choose the parameters used by this overview. Up to six orbits are shown at a time, from inner to outer; use the pages to see the rest.
orbits.empty: Choose at least one parameter to display the overview.

templates.title: Task templates
templates.description: Build reusable checklists here, then assign independent copies from Sessions.
